notes.title: Version 1.024 update description
notes.content: Dear all! Update to version 1.024 adds ladders to this game and fixes some minor bugs. In order to let hero climb onto these ladders new button was added to the control set. It is “UP” by default, however, could be changed in the “Settings” menu.

notes.title: Update v. 1.023

notes.title: Escape from the Lostmoon 1.02 Update – New features, characters and location
notes.content:
Disaster cosmic pilot will encounter with HUGE troubles in our tremendous update! Changes include update in the game content and UI. Game could run on Mac for now (tested on Mac OS High Sierra 10.13.6).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093542/2237de8229dae16c95068d34efb3a9e9c213eddb.gif[/img]

[u]New features:[/u]
[list]
[*] New mercenary enemies including rocket launcher SPG, jet pack soldiers and Minigun Boss (as well as the secret Crazy Boss in his hideout;
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093542/6d9dcaa49905b6387b8767b4acb7fcc7378e04dc.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093542/6d9dcaa49905b6387b8767b4acb7fcc7378e04dc.gif[/img][/url]
[*] Alien enemy - meet Wormy and his acid spits!
[*] Now you can save hostages and turn them into the allies;
[*] More blood and gore;
[*] Entirely new level - “Chemical factory”;
[*] New kind of objects - toxic chemicals, which cause poisoning of game characters;
[*] Several quest objects and interactions were added.
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093542/21fa5ac174e6ae6f28fa73253927a6169d0e8b2b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093542/48ba71f117c2c74ad5c49f06a492cf813765fac2.png[/img][/url]

[u]Gameplay update:[/u]
protagonist’s electric sword can now be discharged when fighting, making player seek for the other ways to survive until it charged.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093542/7991f2d86d217d3c8304ab6f70e651b496d111cd.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093542/7991f2d86d217d3c8304ab6f70e651b496d111cd.gif[/img][/url]

[u]UI updates:[/u]
you can now start playing from the any previously opened chapter;
pressing of the Escape button in the middle of the level now lets you restart level or return to the main menu.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093542/a29e6d2821ca67f34746ee012fe667033cd4bd55.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093542/a29e6d2821ca67f34746ee012fe667033cd4bd55.gif[/img][/url]
